game.name: Motogp 08 (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: MotoGP 08 is a racing game for Xbox 360 featuring the official 2008 season vehicles, riders and tracks. Three categories of motorbikes are available (125cc, 250cc and MotoGP) and three levels of realism (arcade, intermediate and simulation). The artificial intelligence of the competitors adapts to the player's level.
